Information for Food Vendors
If you make pre-made food such as jams, cupcakes, cookies etc. you do not come under our “Food Vendor” category, but rather a normal stall under the category of “Food, Pre-Made”. Please read the information for stallholders for further information.
Please take the time to read our Terms and Conditions for Stallholders before applying, and if you have any queries please do not hesitate to get in touch.
We take a maximum of 10 food vendors per event and as such competition for these places is high. We try our best to rotate food vendors through our events so that everyone has an opportunity to trade with us. To ensure your application is as strong as possible be sure to include the following:
A good description of your business, including a listing of your menu
As many images as needed to showcase your food, rather than the minimum three required 
Your images are clear and show your food, rather than something unrelated or that does not allow us to view your products 
Links to a website, or your social media. If you do not have these, that is ok – it is not a detractor to your application, but we do suggest looking at adding these to your business. 
Please be aware that we do not offer powered stalls for food vendors due to the site and inaccessibility to power.

All fees are inclusive of GST. You must provide your own complete set up for your stall as Perth Makers Market does not provide these items. 
Legal
If you are applying for a stall as a food vendor you will need to provide legal documentation to market management, not City of Melville, via e-mail to erin@perthmakersmarket.com after you are accepted as a stallholder. The documentation you are required to provide is the following: 
Public Liability Insurance certificate of currency
Food business registration with your local council
Food Safety training certificate (if you do not have this is can be obtained online free of charge here) 
Other documents as requested by market management (for events not held within City of Melville) 
How to Apply
You will need to create your own online business profile via our stallholder portal: https://marketlife.com.au/.
Once you have added all information and images, you will be able to apply for market dates in the section titled “Market Applications – Upcoming Markets”. Click on to the date you are interested in applying for, and then you can apply for the appropriate stall size and any relevant discounts. Once you have completed the application for that date, the date in question will move under the heading “Existing Applications”.
FAQs for Food Vendors
1. Do I need to supply my own gazebo?
Yes, you need to provide your own complete set up for your stall including gazebo.
2. Is there power available?
We do not offer powered stalls due to poor availability/access to power on site at Heathcote. If you require power in order to attend please include this information as part of your application. We have a limited availability to offer power in certain locations and do not wish to run into issues on market day with accepting stallholders who require power that we are then not able to accommodate. Please be aware that if you need power provided by Perth Makers Market in order to run your stall you are less likely to be accepted to our events due to this issue.
3. Can I peg my gazebo into the grass?
Under no circumstances can items be pegged/stuck into the grass at Heathcote. This is a very strict requirement by City of Melville and is part of our conditions in making use of the site. Your gazebo must be weighted with appropriate weights (proper weights that are strapped to your gazebo), items such as bricks placed on the base of your gazebo are not acceptable. This is a safety issue and should market staff find you non-compliant on market day you will be asked to take down your stall and leave our event. If you need advice on where to purchase appropriate gazebo weights please contact us.
4. I make cupcakes/cookies/baked goods, do I apply for a food stall?
Nope! We count pre-made food items as a standard stall type as we acknowledge it is a different type of business with a different price point to those making and serving food on market day. Just apply for a stall and select your category as “food, pre-made”
5. You only have two sized stalls for food vendors, 3m x 3m or 3m x 4.5m. My food van/truck is larger than this size, can I still apply?
Due to limited site size and the standard layout we work with we are unable to accommodate food vendors who do not fit within our standard stall sizes.

### Information for Food Vendors

If you make pre-made food such as jams, cupcakes, cookies etc. you do not come under our “Food Vendor” category, but rather a normal stall under the category of “Food, Pre-Made”. Please read the [information for stallholders](https://perthmakersmarket.com.au/stallholder_applications/) for further information.

Please take the time to read our [Terms and Conditions for Stallholders](https://perthmakersmarket.com.au/terms_and_conditions/) before applying, and if you have any queries please do not hesitate to get in touch.

We take a maximum of 10 food vendors per event and as such competition for these places is high. We try our best to rotate food vendors through our events so that everyone has an opportunity to trade with us. To ensure your application is as strong as possible be sure to include the following:

*   A good description of your business, including a listing of your menu
*   As many images as needed to showcase your food, rather than the minimum three required
*   Your images are clear and show your food, rather than something unrelated or that does not allow us to view your products
*   Links to a website, or your social media. If you do not have these, that is ok – it is not a detractor to your application, but we do suggest looking at adding these to your business.

Please be aware that we do not offer powered stalls for food vendors due to the site and inaccessibility to power.

### Legal

If you are applying for a stall as a food vendor you will need to provide legal documentation to market management, not City of Melville, via e-mail to [erin@perthmakersmarket.com](mailto:erin@perthmakersmarket.com) after you are accepted as a stallholder. The documentation you are required to provide is the following: 

*   Public Liability Insurance certificate of currency
*   Food business registration with your local council
*   Food Safety training certificate (if you do not have this is can be obtained [online free of charge here](http://www.melvillecity.com.au/services-and-rates/public-health/food-safety#alert))
*   Other documents as requested by market management (for events not held within City of Melville)

* * *

### How to Apply

You will need to create your own online business profile via our stallholder portal: [https://marketlife.com.au/](https://marketlife.com.au/).

Once you have added all information and images, you will be able to apply for market dates in the section titled “Market Applications – Upcoming Markets”. Click on to the date you are interested in applying for, and then you can apply for the appropriate stall size and any relevant discounts. Once you have completed the application for that date, the date in question will move under the heading “Existing Applications”.

* * *

### FAQs for Food Vendors

###### 1\. Do I need to supply my own gazebo?

Yes, you need to provide your own complete set up for your stall including gazebo.

###### 2\. Is there power available?

We do not offer powered stalls due to poor availability/access to power on site at Heathcote. If you require power in order to attend please include this information as part of your application. We have a limited availability to offer power in certain locations and do not wish to run into issues on market day with accepting stallholders who require power that we are then not able to accommodate. Please be aware that if you need power provided by Perth Makers Market in order to run your stall you are less likely to be accepted to our events due to this issue.

###### 3\. Can I peg my gazebo into the grass?

Under no circumstances can items be pegged/stuck into the grass at Heathcote. This is a very strict requirement by City of Melville and is part of our conditions in making use of the site. Your gazebo must be weighted with appropriate weights (proper weights that are strapped to your gazebo), items such as bricks placed on the base of your gazebo are not acceptable. This is a safety issue and should market staff find you non-compliant on market day you will be asked to take down your stall and leave our event. If you need advice on where to purchase appropriate gazebo weights please contact us.

###### 4\. I make cupcakes/cookies/baked goods, do I apply for a food stall?

Nope! We count pre-made food items as a standard stall type as we acknowledge it is a different type of business with a different price point to those making and serving food on market day. Just apply for a stall and select your category as “food, pre-made”

###### 5\. You only have two sized stalls for food vendors, 3m x 3m or 3m x 4.5m. My food van/truck is larger than this size, can I still apply?

Due to limited site size and the standard layout we work with we are unable to accommodate food vendors who do not fit within our standard stall sizes.

A fragrance brand born from childhood memories, a mother's passion and a deep appreciation for the art of scent that has been quietly developing for decades.
	
	
WA Oud Co The Western Australian Fragrance Brand Rooted in Tradition
	
	
	
A fragrance brand born from childhood memories, a mother's passion and a deep appreciation for the art of scent that has been quietly developing for decades. 
	
	
	
	
WA Oud Co founder grew up surrounded by fragrance. His mother sold essential oils when he was young, and through her he was introduced to the world of blending — how different oils interact, how a scent can shift and evolve, and how something as simple as the right combination of ingredients can create something truly memorable. Those early lessons stayed with him long after childhood, quietly shaping the direction his life would eventually take.
As he got older, that passion for fragrance never faded. It evolved. And eventually it became the foundation for WA Oud Co — a modern Western Australian fragrance brand built around the rich, distinctive character of oud, while staying true to the traditional oil-based roots that first sparked his interest in perfumery.
What began as a small range of perfume oils and beard products has since grown into a comprehensive collection spanning 10ml perfume oils, 20ml and 30ml Eau de Parfum, beard oils and beard butters. All of it crafted with the same intention it started with — quality ingredients, authentic scents and a genuine connection to the tradition of natural fragrance.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
How the Products Are Made
Every WA Oud Co product is made in small batches, and that is a deliberate choice. Small batch production allows for consistency, attention to detail and the kind of quality control that simply is not possible at scale. It also means that when a new scent is being developed, it can be refined and perfected before it reaches customers.
A defining characteristic of the WA Oud Co range is the commitment to natural ingredients. The beard oils, beard butters and 10ml perfume oils are all made using 100% natural, oil-based ingredients. No unnecessary additives, no shortcuts. Different oils and fragrance profiles are carefully blended by hand to create products that perform beautifully while staying true to the traditional roots of the brand.
The 20ml and 30ml Eau de Parfum range takes a more contemporary approach, combining carefully selected fragrance ingredients in strong concentrations to produce longer-lasting spray fragrances. These sit alongside the perfume oils as an easy-to-wear everyday format, with men's, women's and unisex options across the range — from deep and woody oud profiles to sweeter, floral and more modern scent directions.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
Built Around Sustainability
As a brand that values what goes into its products, WA Oud Co is equally thoughtful about what goes out into the world. June 8, 2026
Wondering which stall option is right for you at Perth Makers Market? Our latest blog breaks down each stall type, giving you the insights you need to select the perfect fit for your products and make your market experience a success.
	
	
Inside Perth Makers Market: Choosing The Right Stall Option For You (2026)
	
	
	
Wondering which stall option is right for you at Perth Makers Market? Our latest blog breaks down each stall type, giving you the insights you need to select the perfect fit for your products and make your market experience a success.
	
	
	
	
Whether you're a seasoned stallholder at Perth Makers Market (PMM) or thinking about joining our vibrant community, choosing the right stall is key to making the most of your market experience. With a range of stall options and prime placements available, each offering unique advantages, we've put together a comprehensive guide to help you find the perfect fit for your business.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
Stall Placement and Traffic Flow
	
	
	
	
At Perth Makers Market at Heathcote, we offer a variety of both indoor and outdoor spaces to accommodate our stallholders. Our thoughtfully designed market layout ensures a smooth and steady flow of foot traffic, so you can feel confident that your stall will be seen by the many visitors who love to explore every corner of our event.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
Outdoor Stall Options:
	
	
	
	
1. Central Outdoor (3m x 3m) - $278.30
Located in the heart of the market, these stalls are positioned along the driveway of Heathcote and in the Clock Tower Courtyard. With a maximum of 46 stalls available, this prime central location guarantees high visibility and foot traffic.
Features: Prime central position in the market.
Requirements: Bring your own gazebo, table, chairs, and any other setup essentials.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
2. Riverside Outdoor (3m x 3m) - $253.00
Enjoy a picturesque setting with these stalls located around Gyinning Ellen Brook House and Dandalup Murray House, offering scenic river views. There are 38 stalls available in this area, which is often the first or last stop for visitors.
Features: Scenic river views, perfect for attracting visitors as they enter or leave the market.
Requirements: Bring your own gazebo, table, chairs, and setup essentials.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
3. Playside Outdoor (3m x 3m) - $253.00
Situated around the shipwreck playground and play zone with garden games, these stalls offer the most shaded outdoor spots, ideal for those hot market days. There are 47 stalls available in this area.
Features: The most shaded of our outdoor stalls, providing a cooler environment for you and your customers.
Requirements: Bring your own gazebo, table, chairs, and setup essentials.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
4. Veranda Gazebo(VG) (3m x 3m) - $187.00
These stalls are located outside the veranda, surrounding the Derbal Yerrigan Swan House. With only 10 stalls available, this spot is between Creative Kids Club & Tucci Cafe, near a smaller playground, making it a great location for family-friendly products.
Features: Proximity to family activities and playgrounds. 
Requirements: Bring your own gazebo, table, chairs, and setup essentials.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
5. Dandalup Murray Outdoor (3m x 3m) - $187.00
These stalls are wrapped around the corner of the Dandalup Murray building, connecting the Riverside stalls to the central driveway.
Features: Proximity to entrance. Great starting price stalls
Requirements: Bring your own gazebo, table, chairs, and setup essentials.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
Undercover Stall Options:
	
	
	
1. Veranda Stalls (1.8m x 1.5m) - $192.50
These undercover stalls are nestled under the eaves of the Derbal Yerrigan Swan House, offering ample shade and protection from the elements. A total of 25 stalls are available in this area.
Features: Well-shaded, no need for a gazebo.
Requirements: Bring your own table and chairs
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	

2. Veranda Stalls (1.8m x 1.5m) - $192.50 
Additional Locations added March 2026
As of March 2026, we have added additional Veranda Stall locations in Central and Riverside. These undercover stalls are located under the eaves of Gyinning Ellen Brook House and Dandalup Murray House, offering shade and protection from the elements.
Features: Well-shaded, no need for a gazebo.
Requirements: Bring your own table and chairs
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
Food Stall Options:
	
	
	
1. Food Vendor Large (3m x 5.5m) - $442.75
Our designated food vendor areas offer ample space for larger food trailer setups, with a maximum of 5 stalls available.
Features: Spacious setup ideal for larger food operations.
Requirements: Bring your own equipment and setup.
2. Food Vendor Gazebo (3m x 3m) - $379.50
These flexible food vendor stalls are scattered around the market, offering 7 spots to choose from.
Features: Versatile space for a variety of food vendors.
Requirements: Bring your own gazebo and equipment.
3. Coffee/Beverage/Cold Sweets Trailer (3m x 5.5m) or
Coffee/Beverage/Cold Gazebo (3m x 3m) - $316.25
Specifically designed for beverage and cold sweets vendors, these stalls provide a spacious area to serve your treats, with 6 spots available.
Features: Generous space for serving drinks and cold sweets.
Requirements: Bring your own equipment and setup.
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
Shared Stall Option: 
	
	
	
1. Shared Stalls (3m x 3m Shared)
Looking to split the cost? Our shared stalls offer a budget-friendly option for vendors who want to share a space. Locations and pricing vary depending on the stall, so it's a flexible choice for many. 
Features: A cost-effective option for those wanting to share a space with another vendor.
Requirements: Coordinate with a fellow vendor before applying; we do not arrange shared stalls on your behalf. For more details, check out our blog on how shared stalls work.
	
	
	
	
Finding Your Perfect Stall
We hope this guide has made it easier for you to choose the stall that best fits your needs. Whether you're drawn to the high visibility of the Central Outdoor Stalls, the picturesque charm of the Riverside Outdoor Stalls, the cool shade of the Playside Outdoor Stalls, or the sheltered comfort of our indoor and veranda options, there's a perfect spot waiting for you at Perth Makers Market.
Don't miss out—secure your spot today and become a part of the vibrant PMM community!

## 2026 Perth Makers Market - Halloween Twilight Market

* * *

> 31st October 2026 from 4 p.m. to 9 p.m.

Burswood Park, Burswood

* * *

Perth Makers Market is conjuring up a magical evening at Burswood Park for a Halloween Twilight Market that celebrates the brilliant local artisans in Western Australia!

Get ready for a spectacle featuring the region's most talented creators, each showcasing their handmade wonders. From delectable eats to soul-soothing tunes, captivating costumes, and a scavenger hunt, there's an abundance of fun for the entire family!

Swing by Burswood Park between 4pm and 9pm for a night of artistic flair, community spirit, and the opportunity to explore the exceptional craftsmanship of our local stallholders.

👫👹 Human friends, don your finest for the Best Costume Competition at 6:30pm!  
🐶👻 Furry pals, it's your moment to shine at 7pm with our Doggy Costume Competition!

Both winners will receive a $50 voucher to splurge on one-of-a-kind treasures from our talented stallholders – an ideal chance to support and celebrate the incredible local craft community.

🍭Trick or Treat!!! Want some of those lollies? We encourage you to terrify them and scream Trick or Treat as loudly as you can! Our staff will be dressed up and waiting to hand out lollies to those who get involved.

It's going to be a night to remember! 🌙🌟
